{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and phantom orders
valid_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = valid_orders.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
print(channel_revenue)"}
